title: [29.X]- Incorrect project ledger costs when non-deductible VAT is posted to a foreign-currency project
summary: Fixed incorrect project ledger costs when non-deductible VAT is posted to foreign-currency projects by correctly mapping currency amounts in the VAT-to-job conversion process.
key_points: CopyNonDedVATFromGenJnlLineToJobJnlLine had swapped currency paths: a project-currency amount went into LCY cost and an LCY amount into project cost
LCY unit and total costs now use the non-deductible VAT LCY amount
Project-currency unit and total costs now use the source VAT amount converted into the project currency
Tests updated in W1 and IT layers
quote: The current code adds a project-currency amount to LCY cost and an LCY amount to project cost.
